rows.label: Elena Rybakina
rows.hook: won the Wimbledon singles title with a powerful serve after switching nationality

rows.label: Alexander Zverev
rows.hook: is a towering baseliner who won Olympic gold in singles in Tokyo

rows.label: Aryna Sabalenka
rows.hook: is a hard-hitting world number one who has won multiple hard-court Grand Slam titles

rows.label: Coco Gauff
rows.hook: burst onto the scene as a teenager at Wimbledon and later won a home Grand Slam title

rows.label: Carlos Alcaraz

rows.label: Roger Federer
rows.hook: won a record-setting eight Wimbledon singles titles with an elegant one-handed backhand

rows.label: Naomi Osaka
rows.hook: became the first Asian woman to reach world number one and won multiple hard-court majors

rows.label: Jannik Sinner
rows.hook: is a red-haired world number one who won his first major on hard courts down under

rows.label: Serena Williams
rows.hook: won 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most of any player in the Open Era

rows.hook: was famous for one of the fastest serves ever recorded and a lone major title in New York

rows.label: Rafael Nadal

rows.label: Iga Świątek
rows.hook: is a dominant clay-court specialist who has won Roland Garros multiple times

rows.label: Andre Agassi

rows.label: John McEnroe

rows.label: Venus Williams

rows.label: Steffi Graf

rows.label: Pete Sampras

rows.label: Caroline Wozniacki

rows.label: Elina Svitolina
